_about: How hard monsters hit and how much they can take, by where they are. Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: 'I want Dungeons to NEED a group of 5 and open world should still have danger to it.....not tank and spanking Everything mindlessly.' Tuned with tools/sim_difficulty.py against real creatures and real bosses; read by world/difficulty.py.

endgame_boss._why: Kyle, 16 Nov 2026: 'i can 2 man dungeons without any issues' and 'my 0 gear 0 spec shaman is literally healing an end game dungeon'. On top of the boss rows: a dungeon boss's damage climbs from x1 at level 30 to this at 50 and on (world/difficulty.factor). Tuned with tools/sim_difficulty.py --dungeon, which plays parties of 5, 3 and 2.
endgame_boss._measured: tools/sim_difficulty.py --dungeon, 16 Nov 2026, 4-6 fights a boss, geared and untalented, one simple policy for everyone. At x1.4 a party of five lost Gatewarden Hrun half the time and Pack-Alpha Cinderhound three times in four, so x1.25: five beats every late boss (Hrun 6/6), three and two lose them all. Cinderhound was already at the edge for five (3/4) and is left out of the ramp. The sim's party plays worse than Kyle does: it already lost every late boss two-handed before this, which he wins, so these numbers are a floor on how hard it feels, not a ceiling.

_measured: tools/sim_difficulty.py, 14 Nov 2026, geared but untalented characters. BEFORE: one same-level open-world creature cost a solo player about 19% of their health on average (a warrior 4-15%), three at once were often survivable, and a party of three beat every dungeon boss tested with nobody dying. AFTER, open world at 1.35: one creature costs melee 10-30% and casters 30-50%, two at once usually kills a caster and leaves melee low, three at once almost always kills. AFTER, dungeons (boss 3.0/4.4 for older kits, tuned_boss 2.2/3.6 for the hand-tuned isle and hive bosses): a party of five beat all 25 bosses tested in Ragefire, Wailing Caverns, Shadowfang, Razorfen Kraul, the Drowning Floor, the Cistern, Khaz Varun, the Emberdeep and the Royal Hive. A party of three lost to all but a few first bosses (Oggleflint, Roogug, Gatewarden Hrun).
_field_boss: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026, after a pair at level 17 beat Tidelord Gharesh (5,618 health) in the Echo Isles grotto: 'keep Dungeons around 3x health and 3x damage. So harder than [1.5x] but easier than they were [4.4x]. He did it with 2 people. So why the fuck not.' Every boss, dungeon or cave or named rare, is 3x health and 3x damage. 'boss' (the 97 in real dungeons) and 'field_boss' stay separate keys so they can be split again.
_hidden: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026. A hidden level under a dungeon: 'instead of... 3x HP and 3x Damage... it's 4x HP and 4.5x Damage... they drop at 4 to 5 ilvl... Trash gets buffed too.' A hidden open-world map (skull zone): 'Open world will be 2.5x hp and 2.5x damage.' Which creatures are which comes from world/hidden_zones.py; loot_ilvl_bonus lifts their drops (combat/combat_engine.py).
_frontier: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: Frontier Zones are 'hidden zones FROM hidden zones', 'They will drop higher epics and ilvl about 8 over the regular stuff', 'I'll let you deal with the math'. A frontier cave or dungeon sits one step above a hidden layer (4/4.5), a frontier open map one step above a skull zone (2.5/2.5).
_frontier_epics: Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: 'epic drops from trash in frontier zone can be set at 1%. This is still higher than world drop and dungeon drop! Boss can have epic drop anywhere between 5% to 8% for now.' Trash in any frontier zone: 1%. Bosses: see world/hidden_zones.json epic_chance (entities/boss_loot.py).

low_level._about: Kyle, 16 Nov 2026: 'tone down the difficulty before lvl 10 by about 20% overall. Any enemies below lvl 10 should deal 20% less damage and have 15% less HP.' Multiplies whatever row above the creature falls under, for every creature under below_level.

_hidden_18nov: Kyle, 18 Nov 2026, after a tester's druid went from 1439 to 109 in one hit from Amberheart, the Sap-Mother: 'So lets drop down skull zone by 1x for hp and damage and frontier zones by 1.5x and 1.5x hp and damage'. Skull zones 2.5 -> 1.5; frontier deep 5.0/5.5 -> 3.5/4.0; frontier open 3.5/3.5 -> 2.0/2.0. Hidden layers stay 4/4.5. Then: 'Drop damage to 3.5x for frontier caves and dungeons. Drop hidden layers to 4x as well': frontier deep damage 4.0 -> 3.5, hidden layer damage 4.5 -> 4.0.

heroic._why: Kyle, 18 Nov 2026: heroic dungeons are "Level 60 elites" (world/heroic.py). Every monster in a heroic run is level 60, and these multiply on top of its own row (cave, boss, ...). A first guess, to tune with tools/sim_difficulty.py once heroics are played.
